items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And they brought Duke in to hear me... So right after that, he got Lawrence Brown to... The next time, I was in Boston, and he asked me about coming with the band

ctx.x: Yeah. And Basie played an odd piano and it sounded good -- it fitted. He never did load

the sound you know. Sometimes a guy can play too much piano and drown out everything you know. He'd play the solo while you were playing the solo. That's no good. And Basie just (unintelligible). And let you go right by yourself. And that's a good -- has a good style. Very good band style. Duke had that style too you know. That's a great band style for a pianist you know. Not to drown out the man that's playing the solo you know.
